Hi Alex,

We just signed off internally on the Q1 capacity top-up for EdgeScale (50k tokens/day committed) and I need to get our procurement and finance teams lined up so we can pay on time. A few asks from our side: 

- Can Redwood issue the invoice to EdgeScale Ltd (UK) but route payment to our US parent (EdgeScale, Inc.)? We need the invoice legal name to be the UK entity for VAT reasons, but the remittance path will be the US bank.
- Our PO is ready and attached (ES_PO_78921.pdf). Please add the PO number to the invoice.
- We have a temporary request to move the first renewal invoice to Net45 due to our internal budget approval timing (after which we'd like Net30). Can you confirm if Redwood can accommodate Net45 for the initial invoice for this amendment?
- We can provide VAT / EORI documentation and a remittance contact once you confirm the routing.

Can you loop in whoever from your billing team is needed? We need the proforma no later than Tuesday end of day so our treasury can schedule payment.

Thanks,
Susan Bell

Hi Susan / Alex — Jordan from Redwood finance. A couple of items to make sure the invoice and payment flow cleanly: 

1) Please confirm the exact billing/legal name and address for EdgeScale Ltd as you want it printed on the invoice (including VAT / EORI): we need the full registered name.
2) Confirm the remittance details for EdgeScale, Inc. (US) — bank wiring preferred (we'll include ACH / wire fields on the invoice). If you prefer SEPA, let us know and we'll include both.
3) For the Net45 request: we can accept Net45 for the first invoice but we require the PO reference on the invoice and a signed amendment (we use DocuSign). Once we receive the signed amendment we will book the invoice with Net45 terms.
4) For tax compliance, could you please send EdgeScale VAT/EORI as a single PDF (EdgeScale_VAT_EORI.pdf) and indicate whether the VAT should be shown on the invoice as 0% (reverse charge) or with a VAT line?

I've attached our W-9 for your records (Redwood_W9.pdf) in case the US treasury requests anything.

If you can reply with the three items above, we'll finalize the proforma and the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
